subject: Split invoices for Q2 services / subledger transfer
messages:
From: Sonia Patel <accounts-payable@novenahealth.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-03-22T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request: split invoices for Q2 services

Hi Rachel,

Novena is consolidating payment runs by legal entity starting next quarter and we need the invoices for Q2 to be split across three legal entities so our AR/GL team can post directly to the correct subledgers. Please confirm you can: 

- Issue three separate PDF invoices (one per legal entity) with entity legal name and VAT/Tax ID clearly shown on each PDF.
- Include a machine-readable remittance CSV summary that lists invoice number, entity, gross, VAT, net, and our PO number per line.
- Stamp or include a clear cost-center tag on each invoice line so our collections team can allocate internally.

I've attached Novena's AP requirements and a sample PO list. Our preferred schedule: invoices by EOD 2026-03-25 so they can hit our month-end close.

POs are included in the attached POs_0322.pdf. Contacts: tax@novenahealth.com for VAT questions.

Thanks,
Sonia Patel
AP Manager
Novena Health
Attachment: AP_requirements_0322.pdf (pdf)
From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
To: Sonia Patel <accounts-payable@novenahealth.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-03-22T10:00:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: split invoices for Q2 services

Hi Sonia — thanks for the details and the PO file. We can support per-entity invoices and a consolidated remittance CSV. A quick confirmation so we scope correctly: 

1) Legal entity names and VAT IDs: can you confirm the three exact legal names and VAT numbers to print on the invoices?
2) Net vs gross: do you want the CSV to show gross and VAT separately (preferred for our reporting), or do you want only net lines?
3) Bank routing: you noted a different bank for one entity — please confirm which entity should receive funds so we can put the correct remittance instructions on that invoice.

Planned approach (proposed):
- Generate three separate invoice PDFs (ENT-A, ENT-B, ENT-C) with entity suffix in invoice number for easy matching.
- Produce a single remittance CSV with one row per invoice and a cost_center column.
- Attach the CSV and a ZIP of individual PDFs to the email for your AP upload.

Looping Marcus and Vivek in to confirm numbering, cost-center tagging, and VAT treatment. If that works we will target delivery by 2026-03-25.

—Rachel
Rachel Kim
Senior Revenue Operations Manager
Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Request: split invoices for Q2 services

Thanks Rachel — confirming we can do this and adding the implementation details so AP has everything they need: 

Mapping and file conventions (proposed):
- Invoice numbering: RINF-202603-<ENT>-001 (ENT = ENTA / ENTB / ENTC).
- Each invoice: separate PDF per legal entity; header contains Legal Name, VAT ID, Registered Address, and entity-specific remittance details.
- Remittance CSV columns: invoice_number, entity, amount_gross, vat_amount, vat_rate, amount_net, cost_center, novena_po_number.

Entity mapping (text table):
- ENTA: Novena Health UK Ltd — VAT GB123456789 — cost_center 4301
- ENTB: Novena Health Services Inc — VAT US N/A (domestic sales) — cost_center 4302
- ENTC: Novena Health EU SARL — VAT FR987654321 — cost_center 4303

Attachments included: remittance-template.csv (CSV with header line), entity-mapping.xlsx (mapping sheet), sample-invoice-ENTA.pdf (visual sample).

VAT treatment note: we will include VAT line items on each invoice. If Novena intends to reclaim VAT centrally or prefers reverse-charge wording, please have your tax team confirm the desired invoice wording (we can apply 'reverse charge — VAT to be accounted by recipient' on the PDF if needed).

Delivery timeline: we can prepare a draft set for your confirmations by EOD 2026-03-24 and final PDFs/CSV by EOD 2026-03-25. If Novena requires consolidated monthly statement instead of per-invoice processing, we can change the output; please advise.

—Marcus Lin
Director, Finance Operations
Redwood Inference
Attachment: remittance-template.csv (csv); entity-mapping.xlsx (xlsx); sample-invoice-ENTA.pdf (pdf)
